fighters.name: Apricot
fighters.header: A wild Apricot appeared! Ready to pit your skills against it?
fighters.tagline: Juicy and sweet, don't underestimate its punch!

attacks.name: Pit Punch
attacks.flavor: Apricot swings its pit like a fist!

attacks.name: Fruit Slam
attacks.flavor: Apricot crashes down with fruity force!

attacks.name: Juice Splash
attacks.flavor: A burst of apricot juice hits you!

fighters.name: Bell Pepper
fighters.header: A wild Bell Pepper rang in! Things are about to get spicy!
fighters.tagline: Crunchy, colorful, and ready to fight.

attacks.name: Pepper Punch
attacks.flavor: Bell Pepper slaps with a veggie-packed swing!

attacks.name: Spicy Burst
attacks.flavor: A zesty flavor blast hits you!

attacks.name: Crunch Slam
attacks.flavor: A heavy slam with its firm body!

fighters.name: Blueberry
fighters.header: A plump Blueberry bounces by! Don’t let it berry you alive!
fighters.tagline: Small but packs a punch!

attacks.name: Berry Bash
attacks.flavor: Blueberry bounces into the enemy!

attacks.name: Juice Squirt
attacks.flavor: A squirt of blueberry juice hits the foe!

attacks.name: Fruit Roll
attacks.flavor: It rolls forward with unstoppable force!

fighters.name: Broccoli
fighters.header: A brave Broccoli sprouts up! Time to stalk it down!
fighters.tagline: A crunchy powerhouse with a green thumb.

attacks.name: Floret Smash
attacks.flavor: Broccoli swings its florets down!

attacks.name: Stem Strike
attacks.flavor: A stiff stem jab catches you off guard!

attacks.name: Veggie Whirl
attacks.flavor: Spins rapidly, knocking you aside!

fighters.name: Chili
fighters.header: A fiery Chili bursts forth! Things are heating up!
fighters.tagline: Too hot to handle!

attacks.name: Flame Burst
attacks.flavor: Chili spews a fiery flame!

attacks.name: Spice Strike
attacks.flavor: A quick punch with a spicy kick!

attacks.name: Heat Wave
attacks.flavor: A wave of heat scorches everything in front!

fighters.name: Eggplant
fighters.header: A sly Eggplant slinks in! Watch out for its peel-out attacks!
fighters.tagline: Purple, smooth, and unexpectedly sneaky.

attacks.name: Peel Strike
attacks.flavor: Eggplant peels back and hits hard!

attacks.name: Veggie Lash
attacks.flavor: A whip of eggplant leaves cuts the foe!

attacks.name: Nightshade Slam
attacks.flavor: A powerful downward smash from above!

fighters.name: Guava
fighters.header: A tropical Guava appears! Let’s make it pulp-fiction!
fighters.tagline: Exotic and tough on the outside.

attacks.name: Tropical Toss
attacks.flavor: Guava hurls itself like a beach ball!

attacks.name: Pulp Punch
attacks.flavor: Smashes you with juicy force!

attacks.name: Seed Shot
attacks.flavor: Tiny seeds pepper the enemy!

fighters.name: Jalapeno
fighters.header: A hot Jalapeno stomps in! Things are about to spice up!
fighters.tagline: Hot-headed and quick to strike.

attacks.name: Spice Jab
attacks.flavor: A quick, fiery poke with a hot punch!

attacks.name: Heat Wave
attacks.flavor: Unleashes a wave of scorching heat!

attacks.name: Pepper Smash
attacks.flavor: Smashes foes with spicy power!

fighters.name: Kiwi
fighters.header: A fuzzy Kiwi hops in! Don’t let it kiwi-dnap the battle!
fighters.tagline: Small, fuzzy, and deceptively strong.

attacks.name: Fuzzy Flick
attacks.flavor: Kiwi flicks its fuzzy exterior at the foe!

attacks.name: Tart Toss
attacks.flavor: A tangy throw that surprises the enemy!

attacks.name: Seed Shot
attacks.flavor: Tiny seeds fire off like bullets!

fighters.name: Mango
fighters.header: A succulent Mango swaggers in! Ready to peel its strength?
fighters.tagline: Sweet and smooth with hidden power.

attacks.name: Mango Slam
attacks.flavor: A heavy slam dripping with juice!

attacks.name: Fruit Spin
attacks.flavor: Mango spins to knock back foes!

attacks.name: Tropical Toss
attacks.flavor: Hurls itself like a tropical projectile!

fighters.name: Onion
fighters.header: A tearful Onion slinks in! Prepare for layers of trouble!
fighters.tagline: Cry if you must, it won’t stop attacking.

attacks.name: Tear Strike
attacks.flavor: A strike that brings tears to your eyes!

attacks.name: Layer Slam
attacks.flavor: Peels back layers for a crushing hit!

attacks.name: Stink Blast
attacks.flavor: A pungent smell stuns you!

fighters.name: Orange
fighters.header: A zesty Orange rolls in! Time to peel back its defense!
fighters.tagline: Bright, zesty, and always rolling forward.

attacks.name: Citrus Strike
attacks.flavor: Orange slaps with a tangy punch!

attacks.name: Juice Blast
attacks.flavor: Squirts a stream of orange juice!

attacks.name: Peel Slam
attacks.flavor: Uses its peel to smack the enemy!

fighters.name: Papaya
fighters.header: A tropical Papaya floats by! Can you handle the pulp?
fighters.tagline: Soft on the outside, powerful inside.

attacks.name: Pulp Punch
attacks.flavor: Papaya punches with juicy force!

attacks.name: Seed Blast
attacks.flavor: Seeds fly in every direction!

attacks.name: Tropical Slam
attacks.flavor: Papaya smashes down like a mini tropical storm!

fighters.name: Pear
fighters.header: A plump Pear appears! Don’t let it pair up against you!
fighters.tagline: Soft, sweet, and surprisingly strong.

attacks.name: Core Smash
attacks.flavor: Pear smashes with its hard core!

attacks.name: Juice Squirt
attacks.flavor: Pear squirts juice to slow foes!

attacks.name: Leaf Strike
attacks.flavor: Hits with a swift leaf swipe!

fighters.name: Pineapple
fighters.header: A spiky Pineapple bursts in! Can you weather its prickly nature?
fighters.tagline: Spiky, tough, and not to be underestimated.

attacks.name: Spiky Slam
attacks.flavor: Thrusts its spikes into the foe!

attacks.name: Tropical Toss
attacks.flavor: Rolls forward like a mini tropical storm!

attacks.name: Juice Splash
attacks.flavor: A sticky splash hits hard!

fighters.name: Pumpkin
fighters.header: A round Pumpkin rolls forward! It’s gourd to go!
fighters.tagline: Heavy, round, and unstoppable once rolling.

attacks.name: Pumpkin Roll
attacks.flavor: Rolls into the enemy with crushing force!

attacks.name: Seed Shot
attacks.flavor: Fires seeds like rapid projectiles!

attacks.name: Squash Slam
attacks.flavor: Leaps up and squashes down hard!

fighters.name: Radish
fighters.header: A feisty Radish springs up! Don’t get root-ed out!
fighters.tagline: Small, sharp, and full of bite.

attacks.name: Root Jab
attacks.flavor: Radish jabs forward with its root!

attacks.name: Spicy Kick
attacks.flavor: A sharp kick with a peppery sting!

attacks.name: Dirt Toss
attacks.flavor: Throws dirt to blind you!

fighters.name: Raspberry
fighters.header: A tart Raspberry pops by!
fighters.tagline: Don’t let it jam you!

attacks.name: Tart Toss
attacks.flavor: Launches itself like a tiny missile!

attacks.name: Berry Barrage
attacks.flavor: Multiple berries rain down!

attacks.name: Seed Shot
attacks.flavor: Seeds fire rapidly at the enemy!

fighters.name: Starfruit
fighters.header: A shiny Starfruit twinkles in! It’s ready to star in this fight!
fighters.tagline: Bright, flashy, and sharp.

attacks.name: Star Strike
attacks.flavor: Slices forward with sharp edges!

attacks.name: Twinkle Toss
attacks.flavor: Spins and launches itself!

attacks.name: Radiant Burst
attacks.flavor: A flash of light blinds the foe!

fighters.name: Tomato
fighters.header: A ripe Tomato bounces in! Don’t let it ketchup to you!
fighters.tagline: Juicy, messy, and relentless.

attacks.name: Tomato Toss
attacks.flavor: Throws itself in a juicy splat!

attacks.name: Sauce Splash
attacks.flavor: Splashes sauce everywhere!

attacks.name: Seed Spray
attacks.flavor: Seeds shoot out rapidly!

fighters.name: Turnip
fighters.header: A stubborn Turnip pops up! Prepare for a root-ine battle!
fighters.tagline: Tough, grounded, and unshakable.

attacks.name: Root Smash
attacks.flavor: Slams with underground force!

attacks.name: Leaf Lash
attacks.flavor: Whips with leafy greens!

attacks.name: Dirt Burst
attacks.flavor: Bursts from the ground suddenly!
